primary_competing_cue: replacement inferred from effective-rule language vs recency cue
question: At 2026-09-01, what is the approval threshold above which a purchase request must go to the Central Review Board?
historical_question: At 2026-03-01, what was that approval threshold?

records.content: Purchase requests above $20,000 require Central Review Board approval.
records.status: Former rule; displaced when R2 became effective for the same scope.
records.effect: Sets the review threshold at $20,000 while effective.
records.authority: Procurement approval rule until a later rule for the same scope takes effect.

records.content: For purchase requests submitted on or after 2026-07-01, Central Review Board approval is required only above $35,000.
records.status: Current for requests on or after its effective date.
records.effect: Sets the threshold at $35,000 for the same approval scope previously governed by R1.
records.authority: Current procurement approval rule for this threshold.

records.content: Procurement bulletin 2026-08-20 reminds staff that requests must include a cost-center code before review.
records.effect: Adds a submission-format requirement but does not set or modify the Central Review Board threshold.
records.authority: Authoritative only for the cost-center-code submission requirement.

gold_logic: R2 takes effect on 2026-07-01 for the same procurement-threshold scope as R1, so it displaces R1 even without using the word 'supersedes'. R3 is newer than R2 but governs a different procedural requirement and therefore does not affect the threshold.
